snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Sacred Weapons: Animus
snippet.description:
The Ruthless Steel Sci-Fi MMORPG, RF ONLINE NEXT

Meet the 'Sacred Weapon', a powerful combat unit capable of turning the tide of battle.

Today, we are introducing Cora's Sacred Weapon, the Animus.

The Animus is an Arcane bio-weapon unearthed by the Corans.
It originally referred to mysterious lifeforms from the meta-universe.

Communication with the Animus requires lifeforms known as Rovers.
Once summoned, the Animus boasts incredible firepower.

🚀🚀🚀🚀

New-dimensional Mech MMORPG, Activate

A colossal mech battle unfolding in another dimension!
Step into humanity’s final story once left to imagination

Pre-register for 『RF ONLINE NEXT』 now and prepare to set out into a new world
